items.description: This uses Mera Caar API hosted on Heroku and has its specification on Programmable Web at https://www.programmableweb.com/api/mera-caar. It uses the API for the very purpose the API was created in the first place - to guide the viewer about the components present inside a generic car.
Windshield Repair Tech is a web application demonstrating windshield repair tech api.
A personalized information portal from Mauritius Island which integrates Flickr and del.icio.us.
A real estate website from Denmark that uses Google Maps for tracking the houses for sale or rent on the map.

Amanda Enterprise is a certified, tested, and supported version of the popular Amanda open source backup and recovery tool. Amanda can now use Amazon S3 to backup, archive and retrieve any amount of data, at any time, from anywhere on the Internet.
Japanese Umeshu (plum wine) community web site.
Displays Chicago Metra Rail routes and Chicago Transit Authority, CTA, lines on Google Maps.

By combining the Motel 6 property database with a list of attractions and cross-indexing them in Google Maps, the Attraction Finder functions as a searchable trip planner. Also, make a reservation near a desired vacation spot.
Slick custom interface on Virtual Earth map to search for real estate in Australia with user-defined property criteria and location.
A coupon deal website.
View travel videos from around the world using Google Maps and YouTube.

DFW Restaurant Week(s) is from 8/12 - 9/2/2013. Instead of a sad static list of restaurants that's not even sortable, we took the list of participating venues, put them on a map, and added a bunch of other cool features to find directions, what's nearby, ratings, etc. I have plenty more cool features in mind, more APIs to add, & hope to do it again next year! Works on mobile devices too!
Code It allows users to write code without leaving their Firefox OS phone. The aplication uses the HackerEarth API to help with enabling coding capabilities.
Digital marketplace using modified BitTorrent network for distribution. Allows sellers to list their items, and Buyers to get paid for helping distribute.
A real-time list of the most recent tweets and Flickr photos concerning beds and bedrooms. More feeds to come.
A contributor-based wiki for things to do and places to goin and around Boston.

CuteOn.Me is a simple app to solicit shopping advice from your friends. It demonstrates how a real-world application can use awe.sm's batch link creation, metadata association, redirection patterns, conversion tracking, and advanced stats retrieval. Documentation and source available.
View the locations of over 27,000 major fast food chain restaurants, overlaid on the Google Maps API.

TinyTube is your source for all things beneficial to your children. Ranging from movie trailers to educational videos and funny videos, TinyTube has everything your child needs on one site to be entertained for as long as you'd like.
Search.tl is a Mobile User friendly Web Search Engine based on the Blekko API.

This web site integrates the popular Joomla CMS framework with a Google Maps API integration, to facilitate both geographic search, proximity search, directory search. The aim is to bring the inventory of apartments more easily to the attention of the visitor, and to make it easier for our visitors to find what they are looking for. The directory structure relies on a popular Joomla directory product called K2.
Look for public Flickr photos with this tag-based search.

Want to know how to build an anonymous chat service like ChatRoulette? Check this tutorial on how to build such an app! The tutorial is organised in the form of a rage comic, which conveys emotions in a universally understood manner. :-)
Provides tracking information of UPS packages, with visualized package locations on Google Maps.
Find the best airports for wifi. Based on a Forbes survey of the most wired airports, mapped on Google Maps.
Tweets live on Google Maps.

Fireflies is a web application that allows travelers to search for various traveling options and destinations domestically and internationally. The Allmyles API service has been integrated with this application.

Map mashup for mobile phones. FONFinder produces a mobile-friendly XHTML page with a map of the nearest FON hotspots based on a street address. Maps are adjusted in size for each particular mobile phone model.
Comic strip related art in Brussels, Belgium. Includes Tin Tin.
Share what are you doing now in Japan. Use the map to add a new comment or respond to someone else's comment.
Real-time schedules and rider alerts from Metro Transit on iPhone, Android, and Windows Mobile devices
Littera Report is a source for independent media that promotes all original content by geographic region. Site is still under development and uses Facebook, Twitter, Twilio and Twilio SMS APIs.
